capitalBridge.classification: Reported-date equity bridge inventory and explicit analyst treatments; no assertion this is an Oct18 or Oct25 balance sheet.

cash.minimumOperatingCashRule: 2% of trailing-twelve-month revenue; analyst proxy, test 1%-5%.

investments.taxPolicy: 23% reserve on listed net unrealized gain is analyst liquidation-tax assumption, not a reported tax basis or payable. Do not separately subtract the same deferred tax again. Private base haircut50%; no extra private-gain tax reserved after this conservative haircut.
investments.doubleCountRule: Fixed income + listed + private = short + long investments. Include one decomposition only. Do not re-add Besi/other strategic holdings. Interest and equity investment gains are outside operating EBIT.

restrictedDeferredCompCash.treatment: Excluded from total cash in Note3 already. Do not add as excess cash; leave matching compensation obligation paired.

investmentTaxCredits.treatment: Remove existing receivables from operating NWC. Add discounted expected collection once as nonoperating receivable OR include receipt in cash-flow schedule, never both. PP&E already reduced by recognized credits; do not subtract the same historical grant from future gross capex.
investmentTaxCredits.sensitivity: 0%-100% realization, 0-3 years; reported noncurrent value rounded. No additional future grants assumed in forecast.

currentTaxAssetOverlapAssessment.baseAssumption: Treat as distinct components of other current assets. This is a classification inference, not explicit July filing subaccount reconciliation.
currentTaxAssetOverlapAssessment.support: FY2025 capital-credit receivable233 exceeded separately reported prepaid-income-tax asset148, supporting separate buckets in prior year. July Note8 locates41 in other current assets; Note8 reports335 prepaid income taxes but does not explicitly exclude the41.
currentTaxAssetOverlapAssessment.overlapSensitivityPolicy: If41 overlaps, remove one discounted duplicate bridge addition. Using the full100%-collection tax-receivable PV is conservative; do not also remove it from the separately valued90%-recovery grant twice. Current defined NWC would increase by41 if the same asset had been excluded twice.

otherTaxAssets.treatment: Excluded from operating NWC; may add recoverable value only to extent not used to reduce explicit future cash taxes. Base assumes collection/use within one year at 100%.
otherTaxAssets.reason: Ordinary DTAs are reflected in normalized-tax sensitivity and are not automatically cash. Remaining noncurrent income-tax/other assets are not assumed fully realizable.
otherTaxAssets.overlapWarning: See investmentTaxCredits.currentTaxAssetOverlapAssessment; July41 capital credit versus335 prepaid-tax composition is inferred, with0–41 overlap sensitivity.

debt.treatment: Conservative face-value claim selected; fair-value proxy6000 sensitivity. Do not add current notes to short-term debt again. Issuance cost/discount and $15m fair-value hedge basis adjustment explain carrying/principal differences. Interest swaps are not separately marked to a current valuation date; their disclosed scale is immaterial to enterprise value, not asserted zero.

leases.policy: Operating-expense treatment: rent stays in margin; no lease debt subtraction, no ROU asset addition, exclude lease liabilities from operating NWC. If lease-capitalized alternative used, adjust EBIT, D&A, reinvestment and debt together.
leases.financeLeaseEvidence: FY2024 financing CF repaid $102m; FY2024 reported current balance zero; no finance-lease payment or separate current/noncurrent balance disclosed in FY2025/Q326. Zero is an explicit immateriality assumption, not a freshly reported exact total.

taxClaims.treatment: Tax balances excluded from operating NWC. A conservative full opening tax-liability claim may be deducted only if its settlement is excluded from forecast cash taxes. Do not add 487+118 on top of current/noncurrent balances. Future normalized taxes apply only to future operations. Review DTA offsets before less-conservative settlement case.

pensionAndPostretirement.treatment: Deduct deficit-like book claim once, leave current service costs in margin and omit deficit catch-up contributions from forecast reinvestment/cash costs. Disclosure says aggregate funded status is not material; no invented gross pension liability.

otherClaims.dividendTreatment: If using July26 cash, deduct declared unpaid dividend once. If cash rolled after payment, do not subtract payable again. September payment was anticipated in filing, not independently cash-reconciled.
otherClaims.BISResidualRisk: Compliance audits/training and suspended export denial order remain; modeled in downside business risk, not a second $253m liability.
otherClaims.guaranteeTreatment: Contingent ceilings, not probable losses or additive debt. Review adverse developments; ordinary purchase/service commitments funded in operating forecast.
otherClaims.warrantyTreatment: Already included in operating working capital; no extra EV-to-equity subtraction.
otherClaims.evidence: Latest balance sheet presents common equity with no separate preferred or NCI balance; common share class listed on Nasdaq.

sharesAndAwards.optionEvidence: FY2025 Note11 states no outstanding options and none granted FY2023-25. Q326 shows only restricted/performance awards and ESPP, no new option schedule. Zero option claim is well-supported latest-known status; do not invent Black-Scholes value.
sharesAndAwards.ESPP: 85% of lower beginning/end price over six-month cycle; Q326 assumptions volatility49.7%, risk-free3.64%, term0.5 years, dividend0.57%, weighted fair value$109.16. Unused plan shares are not claims; 1m shares actually issued in first9m are already in common shares. Open current purchase rights count is not separately disclosed.
sharesAndAwards.SBCForecast: Recurring future-grant expense4% near-term to2.5% mature is included in economic EBIT; supported by3.92% recent grant-value proxy, not old amortized SBC. No future dilution/buyback assumption.
sharesAndAwards.noDoubleCountMethod: economicEBIT = revenue*(1 - residualOperatingCostIncludingDA - newGrantExpenseRatio). GAAPLikeEBIT = economicEBIT - legacyScheduledExpense. ValuationEBIT = GAAPLikeEBIT + legacyScheduledExpense = economicEBIT. Old claims enter only in origin share dilution/ESPP liability. New-grant cost stays in EBIT; no future dilution or assumed buybacks. No independent legacy-compensation PV asset is added.
sharesAndAwards.classification: Conservative maximum-performance fully diluted proxy, not a reported exact diluted share count.
sharesAndAwards.commonInclusionAssumption: Assume no material already-issued restricted common shares within the combined8m restricted/performance-unit table; the filing does not separately report issued restricted stock. A duplication correction0–0.5m shares is retained as a sensitivity, and ±0.5m rounded-unit uncertainty is disclosed.
sharesAndAwards.ESPPClaimClassification: Analyst fair-value proxy, NOT a reported current rights count. Approximate1m shares per half-year purchase cycle is supported by2m FY2025 issuance and1m first9mFY2026 issuance; current9m weighted rights fair value$109.16 gives~$109m, rounded110. Full purchase price cash is not an asset because the liability is net fair value, not gross shares.
sharesAndAwards.ESPPClaimMateriality: 0–225m is about0–$0.28 per diluted share before discounting, small relative to operating value. Update if a material change in participation or purchase-cycle terms is disclosed.
sharesAndAwards.legacyExpenseTreatment: Entire reported1.2bn aggregate legacy schedule is subtracted once in GAAP-like presentation then reversed once; exact ESIP/ESPP allocation cannot affect economic EBIT or FCFF. Existing full-value ESIP shares enter denominator once, current ESPP enters an estimated cash claim once. No additional6m weighted dilution, no cash PV legacy asset, no new option deduction.

selectedBridge.policy: Use July26 claims consistently. Opening tax/pension/restructuring/dividend settlement excluded from future FCFF to prevent duplication. Operating leases remain rent; no debt deduction. Old-award future tax benefit is conservatively omitted. No post-origin buyback, dividend or cash flow is treated as an actual July26 balance.

unmappedFinancingAccruals.item: Accrued bond interest and other financing accruals within Other AP/accruals
unmappedFinancingAccruals.status: not separately identified in current/annual disclosures reviewed
unmappedFinancingAccruals.treatment: Selected-claims proxy, not a fully exhaustive debt-like liability reconciliation. Do not report zero accrued interest. Broad residual-claim uncertainty remains; no unsupported exact deduction is invented.

assumptionRationale.growth: First-five-year revenues are rolling-year conversions of fully specified fiscal-segment paths; year1 Q4guidance10250 +75% FY2027, then25%/75% blends. This is a disclosed seasonality/timing assumption, not claimed quarterly guidance.
assumptionRationale.margin: V2 economic margin subtracts1.5ppt from v1 first-five-year hypotheses to support explicit new-grant cost4% versus amortizedSBC~2.3%. Base33%,34%,34.5%,35%,35.5%, fading31%; upside reaches38.5%; downcycle trough23.5%. Residual operating costs include D&A and R&D and are not independent cash forecasts.
assumptionRationale.tax: Near-term13% planning rate from Aug13; drift to15% CY2030 target then toward mature23% base,21%-25% scenarios. Do not perpetuate anomalous FY25 deferred tax/CAMT rate24.5%.
assumptionRationale.reinvestment: 2x initial base remains anchored to1.90x five-year history, with capex/DA and23% incremental operating-capital (21%NWC+2%cash) floor. Same-year terminalS/C=ROIC/[margin*(1-tax)*(1+g)] assures exact g/ROIC transition.
assumptionRationale.WACC: Bottom-up sector beta and separately dated USD risk-free/ERP, with explicitly assumed sustainable leverage and credit spread. Capital and discount origin is July26,2026; Treasury observationOctober16 and ERP observationOctober1 are researched October18,2026. This is a retrospective-information July-origin scenario, not an October2025 valuation or a current October2026 quote comparison.
assumptionRationale.terminal: Base3% nominal growth,31% operating margin after new-grantcost2.5%,23% tax,20% ROC,9.17% WACC. All definitions include ongoing investment and compensation.
assumptionRationale.scenarios: Base/upside/downcycle are unweighted analytical cases, not probabilities. Downcycle FY28 systems-20%, flat AGS and lower other revenue, with positive reinvestment. Export stress can remove half of 28% current China exposure (~14% consolidated) before mix/mitigation; do not count it both in cash flows and an added risk premium. Taiwan interruption is a separate severe scenario, not captured by average country weights.
assumptionRationale.timing: Matching July26 common shares and capital bridge, TTM anchor, and rolling forward years close timing mismatch. Research and rate observations are October18/16; dated model must not be represented as current market-value comparison.

recent.limitation: Three recent upcycle quarters only, selected sequentially; not a ten-year management reliability score. Need downturn and long-term target calibration before assigning confidence premium.

guidanceReliability.extension: Ten-year financial history and Oct13 management target reconciliations read; no confidence premium added for only3 upcycle quarterly beats. FY2019 revenue decline12.55% is an observed cycle reference. Long-term targets are not firm guidance.

shareBasedCompensationMethod.classification: Explicit economic future-grant expense model, not a forecast of amortized GAAP SBC.

recentGrantValueProxy.limitations: Counts rounded to millions. ESPP shares issued proxy volume of new purchase rights; issuance and valuation grants may not align exactly. Neither value is an exact total grant-date expense forecast.

shareBasedCompensationMethod.rationale: Recent-grant value proxy3.92% of revenue and FY25 proxy3.22% support4% near-term future award cost, materially above nine-month FY2026 amortized SBC2.27%. Fade to2.5% is an analyst scaling assumption and is stressed at3%-5% near-term; no cost-free dilution.

legacyScheduleExpense.classification: Illustrative aggregate old ESIP/ESPP amortization schedule. Algebraically cancels and cannot change economic EBIT or FCFF; exact split/timing therefore does not drive value.

shareBasedCompensationMethod.noDoubleCountProof: economicEBIT = revenue*(1 - residualOperatingCostIncludingDA - newGrantExpenseRatio). GAAPLikeEBIT = economicEBIT - legacyScheduledExpense. ValuationEBIT = GAAPLikeEBIT + legacyScheduledExpense = economicEBIT. Old claims enter only in origin share dilution/ESPP liability. New-grant cost stays in EBIT; no future dilution or assumed buybacks. No independent legacy-compensation PV asset is added.
shareBasedCompensationMethod.taxPolicy: Operating NOPAT uses economic EBIT and normalized taxes. No separate old-award tax deduction benefit is assumed; this is conservative. If a benefit is modeled, use an explicit tax schedule instead of adding all DTA again.
shareBasedCompensationMethod.residualCostWarning: Residual operating cost, which includes D&A, expensed R&D, cash compensation and all other operating costs, is a normalization residual calibrated to margins. It is not an independently forecast cash-cost line.

firstYearRevenueTiming.method: Only first rolling-year revenue changes±5%; all later revenue levels remain fixed. firstYearRevenueTiming.interpretation: Near cancellation reflects high marginal investment in this particular temporary timing shock. It is not evidence of low business-demand risk. The separately specified downcycle case is the broader operating-risk test.
